rules._comment: Replaces BOUNDED_CHAN and SEND_AWAIT, which banned bounded channels and awaited sends. TASK-AGS-102 (d5e8ec1a2) made the AgentEvent transport bounded on purpose so a full channel backpressures instead of dropping events, so both rules encoded a retired design. They were dormant only because the regexes were literal (256, agent_event_tx) and the code now uses AGENT_EVENT_CHANNEL_CAPACITY and event_tx; a rename would have fired them. The surviving invariant is that the transport stays bounded.
